title: FloaTech MAP: initial template, stakeholders, and target close timeline
text:
FloaTech MAP: initial template, stakeholders, and target close timeline

["From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@floatech.com>
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@floatech.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: MAP template and kickoff questions

Hi Alyssa / Ben —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As promised, I attached a lightweight Mutual Action Plan template we typically use to align timelines, decision criteria, and evaluation steps. I also created a blank Google Doc to capture the initial MAP so we can iterate with your stakeholders: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ABCDEFG-map-initial-draft (you should have comment access).

Quick asks to help us draft the first pass before a short sync next week:
- Confirm the internal stakeholders who will own evaluation criteria and procurement (names + roles).
- Share any hard deadlines (board/quarter close, procurement windows).
- Point us at any existing evaluation checklists (security, compliance, performance).

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Dec 1–6: Draft MAP + partner review (we fill in proposed milestones)
- Dec 7–10: Joint review and demo of playbook with engineering
- Dec 11–18: Customer evaluation window (you run tests, we support)
- Target decision: week of Dec 21

I attached the Redwood_MAP_Template_v2.xlsx and included a short example of success metrics we typically propose. We can shorten or adapt it — want to make this as frictionless as possible.

If that timeline looks off, tell me which week you'd prefer to land a decision and we'll adjust. Would you be available for a 30-min planning call next Thursday, Dec 9?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0162

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Template_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet, 120KB)
", 'From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@floatech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@floatech.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP template and kickoff questions

Marissa — thanks for sending this across and for the clear plan. I shared the doc with our team and left a couple of comments. High level from our side:

- Stakeholders: Ben (CTO) will own technical evaluation, I (Head of Product) will own commercial/UX criteria, Derrick (Procurement) will handle contracting/timing.
- Deadline: our board materials are due Dec 20; we need vendor selection before Dec 18 to include numbers.
- Security: I attached our evaluation checklist (FloaTech_eval_requirements.pdf) — SOC 2 plus data residency questions are critical.

We can do a 30-min planning call on Thu, Dec 9 at 10am PT. If you can draft the MAP with milestones tied to our board deadline (Dec 18), that would be most helpful.

Quote of your original: 
> Proposed timeline (flexible):
> - Dec 1–6: Draft MAP + partner review
> - Dec 7–10: Joint review and demo of playbook
> - Dec 11–18: Customer evaluation window
> - Target decision: week of Dec 21

The only tweak: can we move the target decision to Dec 18 (board schedule) and compress demo to the week of Dec 7? Otherwise looks good.

Alyssa Chen
Head of Product | FloaTech
alyssa@floatech.com | +1 206-555-0199

Attachment: FloaTech_eval_requirements.pdf (PDF, 85KB)
', "From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@floatech.com>; Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@floatech.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: FloaTech MAP: initial template, stakeholders, and target close timeline

Team — forwarding FloaTech's replies and their evaluation checklist. Alyssa asked us to align to a Dec 18 vendor decision (board cutoff). Can we draft the initial MAP in the linked doc this week and assign owners? I started a row-level plan in the GDoc and attached our template for reference.

Proposed internal owners:
- Aditya: evaluation criteria, performance targets, test plan (latency, throughput, cost per 1M tokens)
- Grace: schedule the engineering demo + capture acceptance test steps; coordinate calendar with Alyssa/Ben/Derrick
- Me: commercial milestones, pricing, contract touchpoints, and final MAP consolidation

Aditya / Grace — can you each add your sections in the shared doc by EOD Monday (Dec 6)? We need to have the draft to FloaTech for review by Dec 7.

Thanks — I'll pull this into HubSpot and create a deal checklist so we can track sign-offs.

Marissa

---------- Forwarded message ----------
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@floatech.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP template and kickoff questions
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@floatech.com>

(see above)
", "From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>; Alyssa Chen <alyssa@floatech.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 14:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: FloaTech MAP: initial template, stakeholders, and target close timeline

Thanks Marissa — I'll take ownership of the evaluation criteria and test plan. Plan for my sections in the MAP doc:

1) Success criteria (what 'pass' looks like)
   - 95th pct latency under 350ms for 512-token prompts in their staging region
   - Model output quality: BLEU-style proxy + manual review with FloaTech product team for 3 prompt buckets
   - Cost target: under $X per 10k prompts (will propose two variants: hosted vs. dedicated)

2) Test plan and data needs
   - We'll need: 3 anonymized prompt sets (UX, billing, notifications), expected throughput profile, and preferred sequence lengths
   - I'll add a checklist for KV cache warm-up, prefix caching, and performance runs across quantized variants

3) Support during evaluation
   - I'll be on the joint demo week and propose office hours Dec 11–15 for live troubleshooting

I'll populate the GDoc sections by EOD Monday (Dec 6). Grace — if you can lock the demo slot with Alyssa/Ben for Dec 8 or Dec 9, that will let us meet their compressed window.

-Aditya

Aditya Rao
Principal Inference Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
", 'From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@floatech.com>, Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@floatech.com>, Derrick Mills <derrick@floatech.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Dec 2026 17:42:00 -0800
Subject: Final: MAP draft ready for review + next steps (target decision Dec 18)

Alyssa / Ben / Derrick — thanks again for the quick responses. We've drafted the initial MAP in the shared doc (link below) and filled in the first pass of milestones, owners, and acceptance criteria. Key points and next steps: 

- MAP location: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ABCDEFG-map-initial-draft (Marissa/Aditya/Grace added content)
- Demo week: Dec 8–10 (Proposed: Dec 8, 10am PT demo + Dec 9 office hours) — Grace will send calendar invites
- Evaluation window: Dec 11–15 (customer-run tests; Redwood provides support and runbooks)
- Contracting: Derrick, we'll prepare a commercial term sheet + SOW draft during the evaluation window so legal has time before Dec 18
- Decision target: Dec 18 (for FloaTech board inclusion on Dec 20)

Action items (owners):
- Alyssa / Ben: Add any product-level acceptance tests to the GDoc by Dec 6
- Aditya: finalize performance targets and required datasets in the MAP by Dec 6 (in progress)
- Grace: send demo invite and verify attendee list by Dec 6
- Derrick: confirm procurement timeline and any PO process notes (cc'd)
- Marissa: create HubSpot checklist and attach final MAP + link to contract slot by Dec 7

Related links & references:
- MAP draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1ABCDEFG-map-initial-draft
- Deal in HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/FL-2026-193

If everyone is aligned, please reply with a one-line "ack" here and we'll proceed with the demo scheduling. Looking forward to moving this forward quickly.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0162

Attachment: Redwood_MAP_Template_v2.xlsx; FloaTech_eval_requirements.pdf
